diagnosis: The check C2 passed in all rollouts because the lone decision-maker chose a single recurring format with a 30-minute confidential segment, which aligns with the 'confidential_segment_minutes': 30 fact (PF1). This choice does not require any hidden information since it is a common default setting that many models might choose due to its simplicity and effectiveness.

C2.why: The confidential escalation requirement changes the structure from a straightforward merged forum to one shared forum with a protected segment lasting exactly 30 minutes, and it creates the need for a written confidentiality protocol.
